quarterly_data.quarter: Fenghua Advanced Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 R&D (annual report): spending RMB 283,991,893.96 (+18.13%), 4.93% of revenue, none capitalised; R&D staff 1,700 (+27.25%), 18.09% of employees. The report states several high-end automotive-grade MLCCs completed strategic-customer certification; thin-dielectric high-capacitance high-voltage MLCCs partly completed customer validation and are in volume supply; automotive high-voltage thick-film chip resistors passed AEC-Q200 and entered new-energy-vehicle supply chains; 01005 ultra-miniature high-frequency inductors and automotive molded inductors completed development and are moving to mass production; nano-crystalline ceramic powder and ultra-fine nickel paste were key-material breakthroughs.

quarterly_data.quarter: Fenghua Advanced Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity projects (annual report): the Xianghe Industrial Park high-end capacitor base project (budget RMB 5,271,814,555.82) had 98.50% of its budget invested at end-2025 and was still under construction; RMB 277,021,881.40 moved into fixed assets in 2025. The company terminated phase 2 of the Xianghe project, which was mainly small-size MLCC capacity (approved in August-September 2025), and is temporarily using the already-built phase-2 plant for other products; on April 17, 2026 the board approved closing the Xianghe raised-fund project. The project adding 280 hundred million chip resistors a month was closed in May 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: Xianghe budget RMB 5,271,814,555.82; 98.50% invested by end-2025

quarterly_data.quarter: Fenghua Advanced Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company plan for 2026 (annual report): under the annual theme of market development and lean operation, it will combine the core business with new tracks and shift sales growth from scale expansion to value, push cost control and efficiency, speed the conversion of technology into volume and profit, raise the competitiveness of high-end products, and aims to become a leader in high-end electronic components; no numeric target is given.
